answer: Each challenge is bound to a future threshold-BLS beacon pulse: its verified signature supplies unpredictable, unbiasable, publicly auditable entropy unavailable when an agent commits. A response must combine that pulse with the task-specific commitment, so a sybil swarm cannot pre-compute answers, reuse transcripts, or farm identities offline; it must maintain accountable, timely participation. Thus every voyage, comet, and mirror instance is tested against fresh randomness rather than cached work.
